title: Spiritmaster build rules at Lv 5
caption: A Lv 5 Spiritmaster no longer reads about Elemental Fusion in Route rules; the trigger step is left out until Lv 14, when the skill is learned.

title: The step appears at Lv 14
caption: At Lv 14, when Elemental Fusion is learned, the step about skills that fire on a condition shows in the Build rules, exactly as before.
